purpose: Prevent malformed finite DWG ELLIPSE geometry from being published as a successful typed record.

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.wireMapping: WCS center (3BD), WCS semi-major axis vector (3BD), extrusion (3BD), axis ratio (BD), start/end eccentric anomaly (BD).

requirements: major axis and normal have squared magnitude greater than 1e-12
major axis is perpendicular to the normal within 1e-6

dxfContract.note: The DXF entity identifies a WCS center, WCS major-axis endpoint relative to center, extrusion, and minor-to-major ratio.

implementation.behavior: DRW_Ellipse::parseDwg applies the existing shared DWG ellipse representability predicate to staged fields before parsing handles or publishing model state. Failure uses the existing reset/invalidate path.
implementation.scope: Malformed ratio/axis geometry admission only; no producer prevalence or native rendering claim.

generatedControls.method: Encode a valid local ELLIPSE frame in memory, replace its same-width ratio BD with a finite value above 1, parse directly, then retry the original frame on the same parser object.
assertions: valid generated WCS ellipse parses with expected typed fields
finite ratio 1.5 is refused and failed entity state is reset
the same parser instance accepts the original valid frame on retry
generatedControls.fixturePolicy: Generated frame remains in memory; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.

validation.build: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dwg_ellipse_geometry_reader_tests -j4 PASS; cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dwg_local_roundtrip -j4 PASS

limitations: The direct control proves the out-of-range ratio refusal and valid-frame retry, not every degenerate-axis variant.
Physical producer breadth, curve equivalence, native interpretation and broader P6 geometry/no-loss gates remain open.
supportClaimEffect: Closes bounded DWG ELLIPSE parser admission for the shared ratio/axis representability domain; no broad support claim is promoted.
